description: Add per-run grouping to the passive analyzer under SPEC S40: `passive --run-manifest <run.json>` where run.json is orchestrator-emitted at dispatch ({run, tickets, branches, worktrees?}). Fold entry-grain usage whose gitBranch is in the run branch set into one reducer; non-run-branch usage within candidate sessions accumulates as unattributed (reported, never silent). Emit cache read+creation per run, normalized per ticket. Claude-only. Retire the standalone cache_tokens façade once landed. NOT agents.md (discards branch data on completion) and NOT a session-set partition (sessions straddle branches). Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-12-tb-27-per-run-cache-grouping-design.md. Depends on TB-26 (S39).
title: per-run cache-token grouping (S40): --run-manifest <run.json> folds entry-grain gitBranch usage into one reducer
